sentence: This project studies how artificial intelligence can be used in spatial planning to guide long-term disaster recovery.
This project develops deep learning methods that keep results fair across different locations.
This project holds a meeting to find ways to keep open-source software secure as artificial intelligence changes how software is made.
This project develops mathematical and statistical tools to analyze tumor sequencing data and understand cancer progression.
This project builds molecular case studies that use molecular structures to show how chemical interactions underlie biological processes.
This project develops models for designing quantum materials by linking continuum mechanics with quantum, electric and magnetic fields.
This project studies how catalyst shape and size and ions in the electrolyte affect the conversion of biomass compounds using electricity.
This project studies how chirality, a kind of structural handedness, shapes the behavior of electrons and spins in quantum materials.
This project uses brain imaging to map how the anterior temporal lobe is organized and what it does.
This project builds interactive exercises that use formal methods to solve small-scale problems in a web-based programming environment.
This project studies how livestock, wildlife, drought and fire affect the stability of a savanna rangeland community.
This project builds a monitoring system for smart homes that uses floor vibration, radar and other sensors to notice changes in how individuals move.
This project studies how changes in genetic organization help groups of lizards diverge from one another.
This project develops a computational design method for thermal energy storage devices whose behavior changes over time.
This project builds an artificial intelligence system that explains its reasoning when checking mammograms for a suspicious breast lesion.
This project studies how a protein called protein kinase C works with other proteins to control growth and cell division in filamentous fungi.
